input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a stipulated Customer-payable termination amount: on any termination by the Company (including non-renewal under Section 4.1), the Company owes half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales in excess of $800,000, payable in eight quarterly instalments. That is a liquidated amount payable by us with no cap, and because our fees to HDI are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month, the formula can greatly exceed three months' fees. It therefore fails the fallback (early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount). Deleting Section 4.2 outright to reach the preferred position would require collateral rewrites of the Section 4 heading and the zero-floor and instalment mechanics, so we take the fallback: a single added proviso caps the Termination Payment at the fees payable for the three months preceding the Termination Date and confirms it is the only liquidated amount or penalty we owe. The existing zero-floor in Section 4.2(b), which benefits us, is preserved.

proposal.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and make it the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.2 requires us to pay HDI an uncapped stipulated amount (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales over $800,000) whenever we terminate, which can far exceed our fees. Our position is no liquidated damages payable by us; as a fallback we accept an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, and we have added that cap and confirmed it is the only liquidated amount or penalty we owe.

ops.text: The Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, and shall be the only liquidated amount, liquidated damages or penalty payable by the Company under this Agreement.

mappings.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
